_doc: Set-piece encounters that happen while you walk. The complaint that produced this file: 'the map is so expansive but enemies are few and far between… more interesting events than just a single lone straggler.' A plain pack is still the common case; these are the ones worth looking up for. `where` decides how it is placed relative to you: `ring` out of sight, `ahead` in front of you, `close` right on top of you. `roles`/`families` filter what may fill it. Everything names what it is in plain language, because the log line the player reads comes straight out of `announce`.

encounters.name: A warband on the march
encounters.announce: A warband is coming up the road.
encounters.desc: A line of folk with a captain at the front. They are going somewhere, and you are in the way.

encounters.name: A hunting pack
encounters.announce: Something is hunting out here, and it is not alone.
encounters.desc: Beasts that have already caught your scent. They arrive together and at speed.

encounters.name: An ambush
encounters.desc: Spawns inside your aggro range, already awake. The one encounter that can genuinely catch you out.

encounters.name: Something with a name
encounters.announce: Something out here has a name.
encounters.desc: A rare, with a couple of ordinary bodies around it. The pip on the minimap you go and look at.

encounters.name: A champion, alone
encounters.announce: One of them is standing in the open, waiting.
encounters.desc: No pack, no help. A straight fight with something that has a modifier on it.

encounters.name: Something feeding
encounters.announce: Something is feeding over there. It has not seen you.
encounters.desc: Sits still until you come close. Worth sneaking up on — the ambush affixes pay out here.

encounters.name: A swarm
encounters.announce: A swarm of them, coming low and fast.
encounters.desc: Many weak bodies rather than a few strong ones. What area skills are for.

encounters.name: A raiding party
encounters.announce: A raiding party, and one of them is better dressed than the rest.
encounters.desc: A champion leading four or five of its own kind.

encounters.name: A circle
encounters.announce: A circle of them, and they are throwing things.
encounters.desc: Everything in it keeps its distance and shoots. You have to close the gap.

encounters.name: The dark answers
encounters.announce: Whatever lives here is awake now.
encounters.desc: Only after dark, and harder than the daytime version. A reason to want a torch and a reason to fear one.

encounters.name: A kill in progress
encounters.announce: Something big is killing something small over there.
encounters.desc: A brute with a knot of lesser things around it — walk in while they are busy, or wait.
